subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Which core contract should own durable subagent lifecycle receipts and audited cancel/steer/resume supervision: the existing task/audit/artifact ledgers, or a dedicated subagent lifecycle API?
rationale: The remaining work is not a mechanical bug fix; it sets public Gateway protocol, persistence, authorization, retention, redaction, and operator-control semantics.

options.title: Extend Existing Ledgers
options.body: Make task summaries, audit receipts, artifact RPCs, and subagent/session controls the single redacted source of truth for lifecycle and supervision responses.

options.title: Create Dedicated Lifecycle API
options.body: Add a new subagent lifecycle/supervision API with its own persistence and authorization model, accepting the added contract surface.

options.title: Narrow To Visibility Only
options.body: Implement lifecycle receipts without steer/resume controls, leaving mutation semantics for a later approved design.

recommendation.title: Extend Existing Ledgers
recommendation.body: Make task summaries, audit receipts, artifact RPCs, and subagent/session controls the single redacted source of truth for lifecycle and supervision responses.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is primarily a subagent lifecycle/control product boundary, and prior review provenance points to steipete as the strongest adjacent owner for that decision.
